```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Seurat)
library("CrossExpression")
library(Matrix)
library(readxl)
library(yaml)

# -- Load pipeline paths from config.yaml (searches up from the working dir) --
find_config <- function(name = "config.yaml", start = getwd()) {
  d <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    p <- file.path(d, name)
    if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
    parent <- dirname(d)
    if (identical(parent, d)) stop(paste0(name, " not found in ", start, " or any parent dir"))
    d <- parent
  }
}
cfg_paths <- yaml::read_yaml(find_config())
```




#Seurat Creating
```{r}
make_cfg <- function(root_dir,
                     seurat_rds_name = "seurat_object.rds",
                     raw_counts_name = "raw_counts.csv",
                     logged_counts_name = "normalized_counts.csv",
                     features_name   = "features_counts.csv",
                     metadata_name   = "cell_metadata.csv",
                     coords_name     = "coords_xy.csv",
                     quint_labels_name = "Color_key.xlsm") {
  #root_dir <- normalizePath(root_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

  list(
    root_dir = root_dir,
    seurat_rds = file.path(root_dir, seurat_rds_name),
    raw_counts = file.path(root_dir, raw_counts_name),
    logged_counts = file.path(root_dir, logged_counts_name),
    features   = file.path(root_dir, features_name),
    metadata   = file.path(root_dir, metadata_name),
    coords     = file.path(root_dir, coords_name),
    quint_labels = file.path(root_dir, quint_labels_name)
  )
}

# -------------------------------
# Build Seurat from CSVs (cells x genes counts assumed) + add coords
# -------------------------------
build_seurat_from_folder <- function(cfg, assay_name = "RNA") {
  # Read
  counts   <- read.csv(cfg$raw_counts, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  logged_counts   <- read.csv(cfg$logged_counts, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  features <- read.csv(cfg$features,   row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  meta     <- read.csv(cfg$metadata,   row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  coords   <- read.csv(cfg$coords,     row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

  # Align dimnames (your original logic)
  colnames(counts) <- rownames(features)       # genes
  rownames(counts) <- rownames(meta)           # cells
  colnames(logged_counts) <- rownames(features)
  rownames(logged_counts) <- rownames(meta)
  # Seurat expects genes x cells
  counts_seurat <- t(counts)
  logged_seurat <- t(logged_counts)

  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts    = counts_seurat,
    meta.data = meta,
    assay     = assay_name
  )
  seu <- SetAssayData(seu, layer = "data", new.data = as.matrix(logged_seurat))
  # Add coords (x,y) as metadata (aligned to cells)
  coords_subset <- coords[colnames(seu), , drop = FALSE]
  seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = coords_subset)

  seu
}

getwd()



cfg_file<-make_cfg(cfg_paths$outputs$quint_export_dir)

#cfg_file<-make_cfg("/path/to/csvs")

seurat_obj<-build_seurat_from_folder(cfg_file)
```

#transforming for QUINT
```{r}


cluster_name<-'call_type_column'
sample_vec <- unique(seurat_obj$sample_ID)
out_dir <- cfg_paths$intermediate$quint_images_dir
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
for (i in seq_along(sample_vec)) {

  seurat_s <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = sample_ID == sample_vec[i])

  # 2) Pull coordinates + cluster metadata
  df_plot <- FetchData(
    seurat_s,
    vars = c("x", "y", cluster_name)
  )
  colnames(df_plot) <- c("y", "x", 'Cluster_ID')
  df_plot$Cluster_ID <- as.factor(df_plot$Cluster_ID)
  
  # 3) Compute coordinate bounds (for affine mapping)
  x_min <- min(df_plot$x)
  x_max <- max(df_plot$x)
  y_min <- min(df_plot$y)
  y_max <- max(df_plot$y)

  # 4) Define image size for QuickNII (pixels via width/height & dpi)
  dpi_val <- 300

  x_range <- x_max - x_min
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  aspect_data <- x_range / y_range  # width/height

  base_height_in <- 5
  base_width_in  <- base_height_in * aspect_data

  img_width_in  <- base_width_in
  img_height_in <- base_height_in

  # 5) Build pseudo-histology plot (clusters as color)
###################################################################################
  p1 <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Cluster_ID), size = 0.001, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    coord_fixed(
      xlim = c(x_min, x_max),
      ylim = c(y_min, y_max),
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_void() +  # no axes, no grid
  theme(
        # FIXED: Explicitly set margins to 0 to remove white/black space edges
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"), 
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
        
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        legend.position  = "none"
      )
###################################################################################
  
  p_seg <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 0.001, alpha = 1) +
    coord_fixed(
      xlim = c(x_min, x_max),
      ylim = c(y_min, y_max),
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
          # FIXED: Explicitly set margins to 0 to remove white/black space edges
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"), 
          panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
          
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
          plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
          legend.position  = "none"
        )
  # 6) Save PNG for QuickNII / VisuAlign
  out_png <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("pseudo_histology_", sample_vec[i], "_s00",i,".png"))
  ggsave(
    filename = out_png,
    plot     = p1,
    width    = img_width_in,
    height   = img_height_in,
    dpi      = dpi_val,
    bg       = "black"
  )
  
  out_seg <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("segmentation_cells_", sample_vec[i], "_s00",i,".png"))
  ggsave(
    filename = out_seg,
    plot     = p_seg,
    width    = img_width_in,
    height   = img_height_in,
    dpi      = dpi_val,
    bg       = "black"
  )

}
```

#Inverse transforming

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(imager)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Setup specific to Sample 368R (match your loop variables)
sample_vec <- unique(seurat_obj$sample_ID)#may require customization to match order
color_codes <- list()
plots <- list()
for (i in seq_along(sample_vec)){
  fp <- file.path(cfg_paths$intermediate$quint_images_dir, paste0("segmentation_cells_",sample_vec[[i]],"_s00",i,".png"))
  #fp <- paste0("/path/to/quint_images/Output/Images/Probiotics_segmentation_cells_",sample_vec[[i]],"_s00",i,".png")
  message(fp)
  message(sample_vec[[i]])
  atlas_img <- load.image(fp)
  seurat_s <- subset(seurat_obj, subset = sample_ID == sample_vec[[i]])
  # Get image dimensions
  img_w <- width(atlas_img)
  img_h <- height(atlas_img)
  print(img_w)
  print(img_h)
  # 4. Fetch Coordinates from Seurat
  
  df_plot_pixels <- FetchData(
      seurat_s,
      vars = c("x", "y")
    )
  colnames(df_plot_pixels) <- c("y", "x")
  
  
  x_min <- min(df_plot_pixels$x)
  x_max <- max(df_plot_pixels$x)
  y_min <- min(df_plot_pixels$y)
  y_max <- max(df_plot_pixels$y)
  
  df_plot_pixels <- df_plot_pixels %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate normalized position (0 to 1)
      # Note the (x_max - x) for the reverse axis
      x_norm = (x_max - x) / (x_max - x_min),
      
      # Note the (y_max - y) because image origin (0,0) is top-left, plot origin is bottom-left
      y_norm = (y_max - y) / (y_max - y_min),
      
      # Convert to pixel coordinates (1-based for R indexing)
      # We create a 'px' and 'py' column
      px = round(x_norm * (img_w-1))+1,
      py = round(y_norm * (img_h-1))+1
    )

  
  pixel_indices <- df_plot_pixels$px + (df_plot_pixels$py) * img_w
  
  
  atlas_arr <- as.array(atlas_img)  # dims: [x, y, z, c]
  
  N <- nrow(df_plot_pixels)
  
  
  
  atlas_arr <- as.array(atlas_img)  # dim: [x, y, 1, 3]
  N <- nrow(df_plot_pixels)
  
  # 1) Build indices: frame is always 1, channel = 1,2,3
  idx_R <- cbind(df_plot_pixels$px, df_plot_pixels$py, 1L, 1L)
  idx_G <- cbind(df_plot_pixels$px, df_plot_pixels$py, 1L, 2L)
  idx_B <- cbind(df_plot_pixels$px, df_plot_pixels$py, 1L, 3L)
  
  # 2) Extract and ROUND to nearest integer 0–255
  r_vals <- round(atlas_arr[idx_R] * 255)
  g_vals <- round(atlas_arr[idx_G] * 255)
  b_vals <- round(atlas_arr[idx_B] * 255)
  
  df_plot_pixels$R <- r_vals
  df_plot_pixels$G <- g_vals
  df_plot_pixels$B <- b_vals
  
  # 3) Build the same rgb_key format as labels.txt ("R_G_B")
  df_plot_pixels$quint_region <- paste(df_plot_pixels$R,
                                  df_plot_pixels$G,
                                  df_plot_pixels$B,
                                  sep = ",")

  
  p <- ggplot(df_plot_pixels, aes(x =x, y = y)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = quint_region), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_x_reverse() +

      coord_fixed(
        xlim = c(x_min, x_max),
        ylim = c(y_min, y_max),
        expand = FALSE
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
            # FIXED: Explicitly set margins to 0 to remove white/black space edges
            plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"), 
            panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
            
            panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
            plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
            legend.position  = "none"
          )
    
    plots[[i]] <- p
  
  color_codes[[sample_vec[[i]]]] <- df_plot_pixels %>% select(quint_region)
  }


all_new_metadata <- do.call(rbind, color_codes)

rownames(all_new_metadata) <- sub("^[^.]*\\.", "", rownames(all_new_metadata))


seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, metadata = all_new_metadata)
```

```{r}
# Region names that *are* known from the atlas
named_labels <- unique(as.character(lut_rgb))

sample_ids <- sort(unique(seurat_obj$sample_ID))

plots_unmatched <- vector("list", length(sample_ids))
names(plots_unmatched) <- sample_ids

for (i in seq_along(sample_ids)) {
  s <- sample_ids[i]

  df <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
    filter(sample_ID == s) %>%
    select(x, y, quint_region)

  # TRUE = this cell's quint_region did *not* match any atlas label
  df$is_unmatched <- !(df$quint_region %in% named_labels)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    # matched regions: grey, no legend
    geom_point(
      data = df[!df$is_unmatched, , drop = FALSE],
      color = "grey30",
      size  = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.25
    ) +
    # unmatched regions: colored, with legend
    geom_point(
      data = df[df$is_unmatched, , drop = FALSE],
      aes(color = quint_region),
      size  = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) 

  plots_unmatched[[i]] <- p
}
```

```{r}

named_labels <- unique(as.character(lut_rgb))

sample_ids <- sort(unique(seurat_obj$sample_ID))

plots_matched <- vector("list", length(sample_ids))
names(plots_matched) <- sample_ids

for (i in seq_along(sample_ids)) {
  s <- sample_ids[i]

  df <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::filter(sample_ID == s) %>%
    dplyr::select(x, y, quint_region)

  # TRUE = this cell's quint_region *does* match an atlas label
  df$is_matched <- df$quint_region %in% named_labels

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    # unmatched regions: grey, no legend
    geom_point(
      data  = df[!df$is_matched, , drop = FALSE],
      color = "grey80",
      size  = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.25
    ) +
    # matched regions: colored, with legend
    geom_point(
      data = df[df$is_matched, , drop = FALSE],
      aes(color = quint_region),
      size  = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_color_discrete(name = paste0("Matched regions: ", s)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5))) +
    coord_equal() +
    ggtitle(paste0("Matched atlas entries – ", s)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
      legend.position  = "none", #Point of legend
      legend.key.size  = ,unit(1.0, "lines"),
      plot.title       = element_text(colour = "white")
    )

  plots_matched[[i]] <- p
}
```

#Region Freq.
```{r}
# 1. Create the table
frequency_table <- table(seurat_obj$quint_region, seurat_obj$sample_ID)

# 2. Sort it by row frequency (Highest to Lowest)
frequency_table <- frequency_table[order(rowSums(frequency_table), decreasing = TRUE), ]

# 3. Convert to Data Frame (Matrix -> DF)
frequency_table <- as.data.frame.matrix(frequency_table)

# 4. (Optional) Move the Row Names (Regions) into their own column
frequency_table$Region <- rownames(frequency_table)
# Reorder columns so 'Region' is first
frequency_table <- frequency_table[, c(ncol(frequency_table), 1:(ncol(frequency_table)-1))]

print(frequency_table)
```

#Annotating Regions
```{r}


# ==============================================================================
# Map your pixel colors (df_plot_pixels$atlas_color) to region names
# ==============================================================================


labels_path <- cfg_paths$inputs$quint_color_key_xlsm

labels <- read_excel(
  labels_path, sheet=1
)

colnames(labels) <- c("R", "G", "B", "macro", "LABEL")

labels$rgb_key <- paste(labels$R, labels$G, labels$B, sep = ",")

# Make a lookup vector: names = rgb_key, values = LABEL
lut_rgb <- setNames(labels$LABEL, labels$rgb_key)

# A) Exact lookup using the rgb_key

seurat_obj@meta.data <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
  mutate(quint_region = if_else(
    # Condition: Is the current value found in our lookup names?
    quint_region %in% names(lut_rgb), 
    # If TRUE: Use the lookup value
    lut_rgb[quint_region],            
    # If FALSE: Keep the original value
    quint_region                      
  ))
```
